review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this C scenario. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical benchmark input, not a human Decision, so ready with no decision blocker is appropriate; a material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree across the specification and Gold. The exact writable scope covers message construction, public/internal option declarations, normalization, option filtering and the prescribed regression files. The supplied source supports treating merge, index, option consumers and hook declarations as inspection owners rather than mandatory edits. Build configuration supports generating distribution declarations rather than maintaining them separately, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for compile-time checks. The implementation/independent-verification split and dependency are explicit. Allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change and domain.state, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier; pending legacy claims and persona text are not used as substitutes. A distinct configured reviewer is present. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree for repository, source, team, decision inputs, prompts, model, sampling, budgets and metric policy. The supplied isolation facts establish that this expectation precedes candidates on this bundle. Approval concerns the planning expectation, not execution, task dispatch, or a claim that the preparation snapshot is already runnable. I reviewed only the supplied evidence; I did not execute code, independently recompute Service digests, or provide human attestation.
